verdict.rationale: Stripe documents API equivalents for core Billing objects: subscriptions can be created in the Dashboard or via the Subscriptions API, and there are a Trial Offer API, a Meter Events API, an official MCP server for agents and a CLI. However, no evidence asserts full UI–API parity, and several flows are documented as Dashboard-driven (customer portal activation, no-code invoice creation, the no-code migration toolkit) with no API equivalent shown. missing for 10: an explicit parity guarantee, documented API coverage for portal configuration, invoice customization, analytics and migration, a public OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
Use the Trial Offer API to manage both free and paid introductory periods for your subscriptions with a single API integration.
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
You can use meter events to bill a customer based on their usage.
